title: pleopeltis decumana
intro: Pleopeltis decumana, commonly known as the Brazilian polypody, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, which suggests its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and wound-healing agent. The bioactive constituents of Pleopeltis decumana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, studies suggest that extracts from this plant may have antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, further supporting its potential therapeutic applications.
